credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/clover.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: WHITE: the flower head is really white (a white part, up to 35%), lit as a ball of florets with green crescents and seams, blue-green past the terminator. Crystal rule. LUNGING. Gesture: duck and PUFF (the pom-pom ducks back, held, lunges out swelling, its florets shiver and a loose floret flies off and drifts). Only the head, its ruff and the loose floret move. Sport: 'Purpurascens Quadrifolium' (burgundy leaves, white heads).
